assertion_audit.fails_if: Restore reload-on-every-code-change: the observed times become 300, 600, ... instead of the independently specified 1800/3600 schedule; ignore an immediate request and 900 is absent.

Allow the first reload before any export: its recorded exported flag is false; the station arm also rejects an export not later than the previous reload, while the admission arm has the finding recorded at line 73.
Drop or overwrite the consumed immediate request reason: last_request no longer contains the independently specified urgent correction.
Omit requester attribution from the request or consumed receipt: the field is absent or false.
Change the fallback window away from 1800 seconds: the default accessor disagrees with the declared default.
Ignore a valid configured window: the accessor returns the default rather than the independently selected 1200 seconds.
Remove the exported_at precondition: a moved identity becomes due at 1800 before exported() was called.
Publish the newest identity as the running one, omit observation, or compute the wrong deadline: the independently specified running/latest/1800 tuple differs.
Never mark exported ticks or retain an export refusal after exported(): a moved identity is still not due at its deadline.
Remove replacement rollback: a refused exec leaves running set to unstarted rather than latest.
Remove replacement rollback: the failed exec increments reload_count a second time.
Restore only memory on exec failure: the persisted running identity remains unstarted.

Fail to advance the preceding reloaded() deadline from 1800 to 3600: the persisted replacement deadline remains 1800; this assertion alone does not distinguish resetting the constructor clock at the same timestamp, while the supervisor immediate-override cadence assertions separately exercise schedule preservation.
Carry an old export into the new image: constructor exported_at is non-null.
Restore station startup identity from the source checkout rather than the imported image: running_code becomes the distinct b identity.
Stop observing the source identity or overwrite it with the imported one: newest_seen is not the independently injected b identity.
Report checkout identity instead of the imported service identity: running_code differs from running-image.
Omit admission exported() after publishing its pass: the persisted tick_exported_at remains null.
Lose the future window or make the service immediately due: next_reload_at is no later than the observation clock.
Fail registration or required-option handling for a valid named immediate request: the CLI returns nonzero.
Fail to persist and return the supplied reason: the returned value differs from the independently specified string.
Omit the requester: the receipt has no truthy attribution.
Remove the initial export/window restriction: an unexported new image is due immediately.
Make the service argument optional or remove usage validation: the no-service invocation does not fail with usage exit 2.
Allow reload requests without a reason: the invocation succeeds instead of usage exit 2.
Remove the specific missing-reason refusal: the diagnostic no longer names the required option.
Accept empty or whitespace-only reasons: either invocation succeeds instead of usage exit 2.
Refuse a valid named request or fail to register the CLI verb: invocation is nonzero.
Discard or alter the request reason: the receipt differs from the independently specified urgent correction.
Ignore the coordinator session environment when attributing a request: requested_by differs from coordinator-fixture.
Refuse the status-only path: its CLI invocation is nonzero.
Publish wrong or missing running, observed or next-reload fields: returned status differs from the independently specified tuple.

Return a CLI receipt without storing the same request: a fresh store read differs; independent literal reason/requester assertions above prevent this persistence check from serving as a self-validating receipt.
Let the supervisor restart before an exported tick: the service window has no export at the restart decision.
Reuse an export from before the preceding reload: the independently tracked export time is not later than the previous restart.
Bypass the shared window or ignore the immediate request: actual restart times differ from independently specified 1800/3600 or 900/1800/3600.
Fail to advance or preserve the automatic cadence after replacement: the final deadline differs from 5400.
Lose the consumed override reason on supervisor restart: persisted last_request reason differs from urgent correction.
Ignore the export precondition during supervisor admission: it chooses restart before exported().
Publish supervisor observations into the child-owned schedule: the fresh record differs from the snapshot taken before the read-only decision.
Ignore a due window after export: the supervisor still adopts the stale service.
Drop the final racing-self-reload recheck: the patched stop is called after the child already replaced itself.
Count the supervisor race as a second reload: persisted reload_count exceeds one.
Stop forwarding the source root into an image child: the environment key is absent or points to the image instead of its source.
Revert the added selected-image identity environment field: the key is absent or disagrees with the selected image directory identity.
Fail the valid immediate-reload command inside the loop driver: the invocation returns nonzero.
Fail to execute both bounded passes while a window remains open: observed pass ordinals differ from 1 and 2.
Restore immediate reload on a changed stamp: reexec appears between the two passes at only 60 seconds.
Fail to resume the bounded loop across an immediate request: it does not complete both passes.
Ignore the immediate request or perform replacement after admission: the event prefix is not pass-1/reexec/pass-2.
Lose code-stamp retry behavior during immediate reload: the refused request is not attempted again.
Fingerprint the first refusal with newer code: first guard code differs from old.
Keep the stale fingerprint after replacement: second guard code differs from new.
Drop the immediate request reason: captured receipt differs from urgent correction.
Omit requester attribution in the immediate request receipt: requested_by is absent or false.
Restore exec into the currently imported old image: the launcher omits the distinct materialized replacement path.
Omit the carried replacement identity or keep the old one: IMAGE_COMMIT differs from the distinct b identity.
Omit the canonical source root during image replacement: SOURCE_ROOT is absent or names an image.
Remove the replacement import proof refusal: exec is recorded despite imports=False.
Remove materialization or call it for the wrong root, identity or active image: independently captured materialization arguments differ.
